primary_claim: In a 5M-parameter GTrXL agent trained on the Craftax environment, linear probes on the agent's activations do not outperform baseline probes on raw observations at predicting candidate goals (indicating no linearly-represented explicit goal), so representation-based retargeting failed; however, transplanting a tiny, modular subset (as few as 500-50,000 out of 5,000,000) of weights from reward-finetuned agents onto the base agent successfully retargets it to pursue the corresponding alternate goals, with consistent weight overlap across independent seeds for the same goal.

effect.metric: average episode return recovery when transplanting top-k% of fine-tuned weights to base agent
effect.value: grafting 0.01%-1% (500-50,000) of weights causes the base agent to perform as well as the fully fine-tuned agent on alternate reward structures; goal-specific weight subsets show strong overlap across 5 independent seeds vs. ~zero expected by chance

contradicts_or_qualifies: Linear probes on agent activations do not outperform baseline probes trained on raw observations, suggesting the agent does not linearly represent explicit goals, so representation-based retargeting (using probe vectors as steering vectors) failed to redirect behavior
The successful weight-based retargeting is argued to more likely reflect immediate, shard-like goal-conditioned reflexes rather than retargetable long-horizon goal-oriented reasoning
limitations_stated: Results on weight-based retargeting are inconclusive as to whether the localized weights reflect genuine goal evaluation vs. immediate shard-like heuristic activation

The agent does not appear to possess a common set of 'goal weights' retargetable toward arbitrary ends — only weight subsets tied to specific goals acquired during training; unclear how to generalize the method to arbitrary goals
This is preliminary research; the representation-based (probing) approach for locating goal-directed reasoning was unsuccessful
quote: we found evidence of partially-retargetable goal-specific reflexes.
